structure.unit: Other Regulated Providers of Financial Services

text.section: For purposes of subdivision A 6, the Commission shall have sole discretion to determine the materiality of any proceedings or determinations.
If the Commission fails to make such findings, no license shall be issued and the Commissioner shall notify the applicant of the denial and the reasons for such denial.
A license shall not be issued to a collection agency, or to any creditor or association of creditors, or to any credit-granting organization or association of such organizations.
